policyActions.text: SNAP Waivers SNAP provides food benefits to low -income families to supplement their grocery budget. Restricting the use of SNAP benefits on non -nutritious foods can help improve dietary intake and clinical indicators associated with long - term disease in rural populations. This State Policy Action captures State efforts to obtain a USDA SNAP Food Restriction Waiver to prohibit purchase of non-nutritious items. At baseline, VT did not have a SNAP waiver in place VT committed to this State Policy Action No Progress

Licensure Compacts Licensure compacts provide clinicians with the opportunity to serve patients across State borders, increasing the supply of accessible rural health providers. This State Policy Action captures State participation in licensure compacts for physicians, nursing, EMS, psychology, and Physician Assistants. At baseline, VT was a member of two of the five licensure compacts No State commitment N/A

Scope of Practice Physician supply challenges in rural areas could be mitigated by expanding the scope of practice of other clinicians who have training and competency in caring for many of the cases currently limited to physician care. This State Policy Action captures State efforts to expand scope of practice for Physician Assistants, Nurse Practitioners, Pharmacists, and Dental Hygienists. At baseline, VT had advanced or full scope of practice (SOP) for PAs, NPs, and Dental Hygienists. Pharmacist SOP was considered limited authority No State commitment N/A

Remote Care Services Remote care services can help expand access to care by allowing clinicians to provide care to rural residents from another location via telehealth, remote patient monitoring, or other modalities. This State Policy Action captures State Medicaid coverage of remote care services and the presence of other policies to allow out -of-State clinicians to provide telehealth/remote care. At baseline, VT Medicaid covered all three types of remote care services and had policies in place to allow out-of-State clinicians to provide telehealth/remote care No State commitment (Medicaid coverage for specified remote care services in place; supportive remote care access policies in place) N/A
